readings: Ignoring transactions with no invoice number, find the invoice numbers that have at least one transaction whose type is not exactly 'Payment'. For each, show the invoice number and the total number of ALL its transactions, including any 'Payment' ones. Sort by that count from highest to lowest and give the top 10.

Ignoring transactions with no invoice number, consider only transactions whose type is not exactly 'Payment'. For each invoice number among them, show the invoice number and the number of those non-'Payment' transactions only. Sort by that count from highest to lowest and give the top 10.
queries:
SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM Financial_Transactions
WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY invoice_number
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type <> 'Payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM Financial_Transactions
WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL AND transaction_type <> 'Payment'
GROUP BY invoice_number
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10;
